hints.title: Dual-Ended Parity Partition
hints.text: Place even numbers toward the front and odd numbers toward the back using two boundary pointers.

hints.title: Opposite Pointers Condition
hints.text: Advance the left pointer while elements are even, and retract the right pointer while elements are odd.

hints.title: In-Place Element Swapping
hints.text: When left points to an odd number and right points to an even number, swap them and adjust both pointers inward.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Creating separate even and odd lists takes additional linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Partition the array in-place using two converging pointers.
